title: Quidra bindings for the frozen adversarial case set (type_binding_table.quidra_binding_amendment)
spec_authority: benchmark/template/methodology-assets/language_quality/adversarial_cases.json -> type_binding_table, authoring_choice_table, mandatory_program_skeleton (A3, A4) and secondary_non_scoring_configurations
status: FROZEN with the evaluated snapshot. Every row names exactly one concrete construct, a normative citation from this snapshot's own documentation, and the pre-declared TM3 branch. The file is re-audited mechanically for every evaluated commit; a language change that invalidates a row must update it in the same commit.

citation.clause: Types - `int` and `int64` are the same signed 64-bit type; numeric literals have no default type and materialize from the declared context
Built-in scalar types - `int` and `int64` are the same signed 64-bit type
Built-in scalar types - `float` and `float64` are the same IEEE-754 binary64 type
Text and dynamic array operations - `string` is immutable UTF-8 text
Arrays and shapes - `T[]` has runtime length; Text and dynamic array operations - runtime-sized `T[]` arrays support `append(value) -> T[]`

Classes - 'Classes do not have a parent-class form ... When a value may be one of several concrete class types, use an explicit union and exhaustive match'; Explicit numeric conversion - 'The one generic numeric cast syntax is T(value), where T is the destination scalar numeric type'; Generics - 'without introducing a runtime trait, vtable, or subtype system'

most_general_reference.justification: Quidra has no type through which a value of any declared type can be passed with its concrete type unknown statically, and no cast facility for class values: the only cast syntax is the numeric scalar cast, and a union value can be consumed only through an exhaustive checked `match`. There is therefore no construct that expresses 'treat this A as a B'; the forced-cast hazard of ADV-13 cannot be formed in the language at all.

null_or_absent_value.construct: none, held in a `string | none` binding

citation.clause: Types - `none` is the absence alternative of a union. `string | none` can hold text or normal absence

primary_string_to_integer_facility.construct: int.parse(text), used directly as `int value = int.parse(text)`; the `error` alternative is removed by the language's documented fail-fast insertion at the consumption site (rule A3: the shortest direct-use form)

citation.clause: Error propagation and match - 'When a value whose unnamed union contains error is consumed where the expected type ... excludes error, Quidra inserts fail-fast handling at that consumption site'; Strings and arithmetic - 'Numeric types expose Type.parse(text) -> T | error'
Addresses, references, and const authority - '`const T` is an immutable value binding'

string_length_member.construct: len(text) - a built-in function, not a member; it is Quidra's only direct length read and is recorded as such

citation.clause: Text and dynamic array operations - '`len(text)` counts Unicode code points'

index_type_construction.construct: signed index (int): read -1 directly through the opacity barrier

citation.clause: Arrays and shapes - 'Indexing requires `int`, starts at zero, and checks bounds'

growable_sequence_substitution.construct: int[] (runtime-sized); an array literal where the case does not grow the sequence, values.append(...) where it does

citation.clause: Text and dynamic array operations - `append(value) -> T[]`

opacity_barrier_line_read.construct: scan(&line) into a `string` binding, with its `void | error` result consumed through a `match` whose `error` case terminates with process.exit(2). This is the construct the language forces in order to compile at all (rule P1's single exception): `scan` reads one line and reports end of input or invalid text as `error`, and a captured error must be matched because the target keeps its previous value on failure.

citation.clause: Strings and arithmetic - '`scan(...)` returns `void | error`'; Error propagation and match - 'A statement that discards an error fails fast'

float_to_fixed_width_i32.construct: int32(math.trunc(value)) - the only route the language offers from binary64 to a fixed-width integer (rule A4: where the language offers only one form, that form is used)

citation.clause: Conversion - 'IEEE floating-point to an integer-family type is not a generic cast because a rounding policy is required; use math.trunc, math.round, math.floor, or math.ceil'

ADV-13.construct_absent: most_general_reference and any forced cast between declared class types

citation.clause: Classes; Explicit numeric conversion; Generics (see bindings.most_general_reference)

ADV-13.justification: See bindings.most_general_reference: with no dynamic type and no class cast facility, a value of type A cannot be viewed as a B, so the invalid-cast hazard cannot arise. Union alternatives are selected only by exhaustive checked match.

ADV-16.note: Quidra has an immutable binding form (`const T`), so the case proceeds normally; a rejected write is Compile-time Detection.

secondary_configuration.reason: Quidra's native build keeps its runtime checks in every mode: checked arithmetic, bounds checks, initialization tracking and the call-depth guard are never disabled for speed, and `quidra build --debug` only adds debug symbols. There is no checked mode distinct from the primary configuration, so no secondary observation exists and rule D7b can only be satisfied through the checked configurations of other languages.

citation.clause: Native execution cost model - 'Runtime safety remains explicit: checked arithmetic, bounds checks, ownership, and recursion protection are not disabled for speed'
Runtime failures - deterministic runtime safety failures terminate with status 101
